title: Circuit breaker
description: Implement class CircuitBreaker(failure_threshold, reset_timeout, half_open_successes=1) driven by caller-supplied times. Methods: state(now) -> 'closed'|'open'|'half_open', allow(now) -> bool, record_success(now), record_failure(now). Closed: failure_threshold consecutive failures open the breaker at that time; a success resets the failure count. Open: allow is False until now - opened_at >= reset_timeout, after which the state is half_open. Half_open: allow is True; half_open_successes successes close the breaker, any failure reopens it with opened_at = now.
invariants: Constructor raises ValueError if failure_threshold < 1, reset_timeout < 0 or half_open_successes < 1.
Only consecutive failures count in closed state.
Exactly reset_timeout elapsed time is enough to enter half_open.
A failure in half_open restarts the full reset_timeout wait.
When the breaker closes again the failure count is zero.
